name: MiseOS Runner
description: Reproducible base runtime image for registry validation, policy checks, analytics generation, and agent execution.

changePolicy.major: Requires maintainer approval, migration notes, and compatibility audit.
changePolicy.minor: Requires changelog, analytics diff, and policy dry run.
changePolicy.patch: May be merged after validation if permissions and trust metadata do not expand.

release.currentStrategy: validate, analyze, publish only through signed workflows

answers.does: Reproducible base runtime image for registry validation, policy checks, analytics generation, and agent execution.
answers.changed: Expanded v0.2 manifest with analytics, trust, release, and agent execution metadata.
answers.safe: Safe only within declared executionMode and permission gates.
answers.agentExecutable: Yes, if manifest validation passes and requested permissions match the registry contract.
